landing.faqQuestion1: Can I try the gym before joining?
landing.faqAnswer1: Yes. Send a free-trial request and our team will follow up to help arrange your visit.
landing.faqQuestion2: What should I bring for my first visit?
landing.faqAnswer2: Bring comfortable training clothes, clean indoor shoes and a water bottle. Our team can help you get oriented.
landing.faqQuestion3: Can I train with a coach?
landing.faqAnswer3: Yes. Browse the available coach profiles and request a session after creating your member account.
landing.faqQuestion4: How do I choose a membership?
landing.faqAnswer4: Compare the current durations and prices below. You can start with a free trial before you decide.
landing.faqQuestion5: Does the app provide medical or dietetic advice?
landing.faqAnswer5: Nutrition guidance is informational and is not medical advice. Talk to a qualified health professional about medical needs.

legal.privacyIntro: We use the information you provide to operate your account and respond to your requests.
legal.privacyAccountsCopy: Account details and profile information are used to provide sign-in, membership and training services.
legal.privacyCookiesCopy: Essential cookies support secure sign-in. Your language, theme and consent preferences are stored in your browser.
legal.privacyRequestsCopy: You can request an export of your account information or request account deletion through the available account services.
legal.termsIntro: Use the platform respectfully and provide accurate information when creating an account or requesting a free trial.
legal.termsHealthCopy: Exercise and nutrition information is general guidance, not medical advice. Choose activity appropriate to you and consult a qualified professional when needed.
